captions.detailed: This 3D model features a pair of wide-angle astronomy porro-prism binoculars. It consists of two large, dark-matte 70mm objective barrels connected by a robust central hinge mechanism. The body is finished in a clean matte black, with light-blue tinted optical lenses at the front and two cylindrical eyepieces at the rear. The central hinge, focus wheel, and eyepiece components are detailed in contrasting grey and black plastics.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of wide-angle astronomy porro-prism binoculars. The assembly should feature two large 70mm objective barrels, a central revolute hinge joining them, a center focus wheel, and two adjustable eyecup barrels on the eyepieces, using matte black and dark gray materials.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject structure. The main body halves (left and right barrels) are constructed by combining cylinders for the objective lenses, larger cylindrical housings for the porro-prisms, and angled transition tubes. The central hinge is modeled using a series of interlocking cylinders and blocks along the central axis, with a rotary focus wheel positioned near the eyepieces. Each eyepiece is built from concentric cylinders representing the optical tubes and twist-lock eyecups, with all components positioned relative to each other using local translation and rotation transforms.
